name: heart
description: Represents a like, favorite, or appreciation action. On hover or trigger, the heart stroke path draws into shape (0.3s), executes a rhythmic double heartbeat pulse (1 → 1.15 → 1 → 1.08 → 1), and fills smoothly before settling into rest state.

animation.description: Sequential story animation: pathLength 0→1 stroke draw (0.3s) followed by a double heartbeat pulse (scale [1, 1.15, 1, 1.08, 1], 0.35s) and fill transition. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: When used in a toggle or like button, pair with aria-pressed state to communicate active state.
